LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Maza.label: maza
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Maza.description: Flat barley cakes kneaded with olive oil and honey, served with a few olives and a lump of cheese.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Skewers.label: obeliskos skewers
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Skewers.description: Lamb grilled on iron spits with peppers, served with olives. The smell of them drifts over every festival and every camp.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Plakous.label: plakous
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Plakous.description: Layers of thin dough and soft cheese soaked in honey. Athletes are given it after the games, and nobody refuses. A small treat: eating it is a little joy.
